sample_data.method: Use the sidebar Demo case selector to load any of the 25 bundled cases from data/P12_personal_ledger_public.json; equivalent hidden-case values can be entered through Settings, Add expense and Savings.
sample_data.reset_instructions: Choose Demo case > — none — to unload a demo into a fresh ledger, or click Reset data and type RESET to clear all browser data.

problem_solving_method: We separated P12 into deterministic financial calculations and correction-first user workflows: integer paisa for all money, exact half-up DPS simulation, ledger-date monthly aggregation, explainable category forecasts with an early-sample floor, user-verified receipt prefilling, and anonymous cloud sync with local fallback. Published fixtures plus targeted browser regressions verified the required flows and responsive layout.

R1.evidence: Settings configures salary; Add expense supports manual entry and editable receipt-prefilled values; api/ocr.js implements vision extraction.

R2.evidence: Overview renders monthly spent vs salary, remaining money, prior-month pace, category comparison, daily/cumulative charts, largest expenses and the complete ledger; implemented in app.js renderDashboard/renderTrend/renderDaily.

R3.evidence: Forecast renders remaining expected spend, projected total/balance, specific insights, per-category methodology, explainability and a non-persistent what-if simulator; implemented in app.js analyze/buildInsights/renderForecast.

R4.evidence: Savings creates named item goals with target and contribution, forecast-aware affordability notes, completion dates and exact DPS compound-interest comparison; implemented in app.js pocketPlan/renderPockets/dpsInterest.

team_members.major_contribution: Designed, implemented, deployed and tested the complete Punji product: frontend workflows and responsive UI, ledger and forecast calculations, DPS goals, receipt OCR, Neon persistence, exports, safety/accessibility hardening and documentation.

major_design_decisions: Store all money as integer paisa so totals and the required DPS half-up rounding remain exact.
Keep forecasts deterministic and explainable, and require day 7 plus three category transactions before run-rate extrapolation to avoid misleading early alarms.
Use receipt AI only to prefill editable fields; the user verifies and explicitly saves every expense.
Use an anonymous per-browser ledger ID with Neon sync and localStorage fallback to avoid account setup while preserving data.
Use dependency-free vanilla frontend code so judges can audit and run it with any static server.
known_limitations: There are no user accounts; clearing browser storage or changing browsers creates a different anonymous ledger.
Receipt reading depends on the configured external vision service and network access; manual entry remains available.
Savings pockets model forward plans rather than historical deposits or withdrawals.
Existing merchant capitalization is normalized, but spelling mistakes require user correction.
Arbitrary fixture JSON is not uploaded directly; bundled public cases can be selected and equivalent hidden-case values can be entered manually.
